vibe: Bloomberg terminal meets esports leaderboard meets scientific lab. Data-dense, sterile, serious, competitive.

spacing_and_layout.alignment: Left-aligned data, strict columns. Use CSS Subgrid alignment for tables where possible.

components.cards: Flat solid background (bg-surface), 1px solid border (border-zinc-800), max rounded-sm. No shadow, rely on 1px strokes for definition.
components.buttons: Square edges, solid accent colors or ghost with 1px border. font-mono uppercase text-sm.
components.badges: Transparent background, 1px border matching accent color, monospace text.
components.tables: Dense rows, border-b border-zinc-800. Data columns right-aligned, text left-aligned.
components.tickets_grid: 10x8 grid for 80 numbers. Small squares (e.g. w-6 h-6 or w-8 h-8). Unselected: border-zinc-800 text-zinc-600. Selected: solid accent color. Hit: solid success color with a subtle drop-shadow glow.
components.venn_diagram: CSS or SVG circles with mix-blend-screen for Judge consensus visualization.
components.charts: Recharts with monospace axes, zero grid lines, sharp line tension (step or linear, no smooth curves).

motion.hover: Instant background color shifts, no slow fades. Terminal-like snappiness.
motion.entrance: Staggered fade-in (opacity 0 to 1, translate-y-1) for list items. Use 0.15s ease-out.
motion.live_updates: Flash effect (bg-zinc-800 to transparent over 0.5s) when new draw numbers arrive to simulate live data ingestion.

images.description: Abstract blue lines and dots on black background (data network). Use at 10-15% opacity behind the main Arena dashboard.
Server rack texture. Use for empty states or purely decorative lab atmosphere sections, heavily darkened and low opacity.

sections: Header: Countdown timer (font-mono, text-6xl, tracking-tighter) & Last Draw Winning Numbers ticker
Middle: Three Player AI Cards side-by-side (Alpha, Beta, Gamma) displaying current status, reputation, XP, win streak
Bottom: Live match ticker (console log style) and Judge Consensus Panel
Top: Podium or Top Stats summary (Lifetime Score, Titles)
Main: Sortable data table with monospace stats (Win %, Avg Hit Rate, Best picks)

draw_history.layout: Split view: History list on left, Draw Details on right.
sections: Details: The 20 winning numbers displayed prominently.
AIs' Tickets: Visual grid showing each AI's hits vs misses.
Judge Notes: Monospace text block resembling a log output.
Venn-style consensus visualization (overlapping circles of Alpha, Beta, Gamma picks).
Prediction Release log: Whether predictions are released, with logical reasoning log.
Header: AI identity, version, overall reputation.
Charts: Win rate trend, hit rate trend over time (Recharts line charts).

testing.attributes: All interactive elements (buttons, links, tabs, sort headers) MUST have `data-testid` in kebab-case. Example: data-testid='alpha-ai-card'

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette. Do NOT use standard Vercel default styles. Use #050505 for background.
Use grid lines (border-zinc-800) heavily to separate sections, creating a terminal/instrument panel feel. Embrace 'Grid Borders (The Technical Look)'.
For the 80-number Keno ticket visualization, map an array of 1 to 80 and style with grid-cols-10. Use distinct colors for unpicked, picked, and hit.
Ensure the countdown and live numbers use the JetBrains Mono font for precise tabular lining.
Avoid large border radii. Use `rounded-sm` or `rounded-none` globally to keep the sharp, scientific aesthetic.
When displaying AI predictions, apply colors specifically mapped to Alpha (Cyan), Beta (Yellow), Gamma (Red) to keep identity consistent across all screens.
